pairs.why: B is built like a real locomotive, with a grille cowcatcher, side rods, a coal tender and a believable cab, all in the clean semi-detailed look of the bus and bicycle; A is a chunky toy with a slab front that reads as too toy-like.

A sits in a soft painterly desert scene with depth and real-looking proportions like the bus and bicycle cards, while B's tight profile crop, flat backdrop and smooth plastic red parts make it look more like a toy.
A's chunky, plump gold star with a big faceted gem matches the soft, weighty finish of the ring box and trumpet, while B's thinner, flatter star and small cabochon look weaker and less finished.
